title: WBCA Shares a Thanksgiving Greeting for Laredo
excerpt: The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association shared a Thanksgiving greeting Thursday morning from its WBCA family to Laredo families, expressing gratitude for the community and its traditions.
content:
The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association shared a Thanksgiving greeting Thursday morning, Nov. 26, 2026, wishing Laredo families a happy Thanksgiving.

The message, posted to the association's Facebook page, said the WBCA family is grateful for the community and thankful for its traditions.
